name: Taskbar
author: joshjal
description: One icon per open window on this monitor, with a live hover preview

barWidget.description: One icon per open window on this monitor, with a live hover preview

schema.label: Icon size
schema.description: Icon size at rest. Icons shrink toward the minimum as more windows open on the monitor.

schema.label: Minimum icon size
schema.description: Floor for the automatic shrink, so a busy monitor never collapses the icons entirely.

schema.label: Maximum icons
schema.description: Windows past this count collapse into a "+N" overflow chip. 0 means unlimited.

schema.label: Include special workspaces
schema.description: Also show windows parked on special workspaces, such as the scratchpad.

schema.label: Hover preview delay (ms)
schema.description: How long to hover before the live preview opens. Set to -1 to turn previews off entirely.

schema.label: Preview width (px)
schema.description: Width of the live hover preview.

schema.label: Preview max height (px)
schema.description: Height cap for the live hover preview; the thumbnail keeps the window's aspect ratio.
